Container.Name: nightcrawler
Container.Overview:
nightcrawler watches marketplaces and shops for new, used and refurbished products. Watchlists run on a schedule; listings are filtered by real specs read from the titles (brand, storage, RAM, CPU, screen, ...) like on Geizhals, with price history, price-drop and sold detection, a deal score and notifications through Apprise (Discord, Telegram, ntfy, e-mail, ...).
Sources: the official eBay Browse API (free developer keys), any Shopify store, and any other shop through CSS selectors.
Optional AI with your Claude Pro/Max subscription: relevance filter per watchlist in plain language, natural-language search, deal check. Get a token in the container console with: claude setup-token. Then paste it into the template or into Settings > AI in the web UI.
Open the web UI after the start. A demo source with test data is set up on the first start. Watchlists, sources and settings are managed in the web UI and stored in appdata.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: crawler scraper price tracker deals ebay shopify geizhals used refurbished alerts claude ai

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, settings and the Claude login. Back this up.

Config.Name: Claude subscription token
Config.Description: Optional, for the AI features. Run claude setup-token in the container console and paste the sk-ant-oat... token here (or in Settings > AI).

Config.Name: Username
Config.Description: Protect the web UI with a login (HTTP basic auth). Set it together with Password. Empty = no login.

Config.Name: eBay enabled
Config.Description: Enable the eBay source on the first start (later: Sources page in the web UI). Needs the two keys below.

Config.Name: eBay client ID
Config.Description: App ID of a free Production keyset from developer.ebay.com.

Config.Name: eBay client secret
Config.Description: Cert ID of the same keyset.

Config.Name: Anthropic API key
Config.Description: Alternative to the subscription, billed per token. Choose the Anthropic API key backend in Settings > AI.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as. Files in Data get this owner.
